answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 61753 Country: OM Title: madhi flow breaks wudhu makes namaz difficult Question: I have a problem. I often have sexual thoughts because of which my wudhu breaks. Often sexual thoughts come during namaz. My madhi sometime keeps flowing for up to half an hour even after sexual thoughts have subsided. If I try to reoffer namaz the flow of madhi breaks my wudhu again. In such a case where madhi is flowing and time break given by my employer for namaz is getting over and I have to go back to office, what should I do? Can I offer qaza namaz later as time break given by employer for namaz gets over. Will I be a sinner if I choose to pray namaz later because of madhi problem? Answer ID: 61753 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 39/39/SD=01/1437) If you have not married yet try to marry soon. Make yourself busy in useful and good deeds and safeguard your eyes. Also consult any expert physician. Make it sure that you do not miss any salah. One may offer salah in the office due to compulsion. After adopting all possible measures if you do not find a way to offer salah in time and you offer it later then it is hoped that you shall not be taken accountable. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
